news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.1% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.28 (vs ₹1.17 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.28 (down from ₹1.17 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹665.9m (down 25% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹26.1m (down 75% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 3.9% (down from 12% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by lower revenue.
